name: Mary Ann "Molly" Hardin (Ball)
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 35458870 (Moses Ball Jr., 1748–1831, Ball Cemetery, Hawkins County)
Bonnie Ball, "The Balls of Fairfax and Stafford in Virginia" (1961)
Hawkins County, Tennessee, will abstracts (Moses Ball, will dated 13 Dec 1831)
notes: Wife of Moses Ball Jr., married about 1770; named as Molly in his 1831 will. Find a Grave gives her birth as 1754 and her parents as William Hardin and Patty Green (unverified).
